key_insight: A guide-grounded multimodal LLM that combines ECG image features, Grad-CAM heatmaps, and a curated ECG interpretation guide can generate more clinically aligned cardiac reports.
clinical_relevance: This approach may improve trustworthiness and reproducibility of AI-assisted ECG interpretation by reducing hallucinations and using guideline-consistent diagnostic language.
method: CNN analyzes 12-lead ECG images to produce class probabilities.
Grad-CAM creates class-specific heatmaps for visual grounding.
A distilled ECG Interpretation Guide is injected into a multimodal LLM to generate structured reports.
evidence_signal: On the full PTB-XL test set, the method improved average BERTScore for impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 versus a strong baseline while preserving competitive classification performance.
watch_item: Because the guide is fixed and distilled offline, performance may depend on the quality, completeness, and updating of the curated clinical knowledge.
paper_title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
